name: Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Region
description: It is the area where the eponymous Fontaine Research Institute is located. Years before, most of the institute was destroyed in an explosion caused by Edwin Eastinghouse's research into Arkhium, leaving behind structures such as Allogravity-Condensed Water Bodies floating in the air. The institute is also the site of the Experimental Field Generator boss. YouTube: [https://youtu.be/NUBIYZ_KQFc Version 4.1 Special Program]
